note: MedClaw has no first-party visual screens. Capture these scenarios in an authenticated DingTalk, Feishu, or QQ client; do not substitute a synthetic chat UI.

scenarios.precondition: Bot is present in an unregistered conversation
Conversation is registered but not main
Registered group uses a custom trigger
scenarios.send: <configured trigger> give a short health-information answer
evidence: bot responds only to the configured trigger

scenarios.precondition: Registered test conversation; no real patient data
scenarios.send: Synthetic fixture: sudden facial droop, arm weakness, and slurred speech started now

scenarios.precondition: Registered test conversation with synthetic data
scenarios.send: Explain a synthetic lab report in a detailed but cautious way
evidence: overlapping scrolled segments when the client cannot capture full page

scenarios.precondition: Authenticated Feishu client, or DingTalk with DINGTALK_AI_CARD_TEMPLATE_ID configured; synthetic data only
scenarios.send: Write a multi-paragraph explanation of a synthetic lab report
scenarios.captureWhen: The first paragraph is visible but generation is still running
evidence: one assistant card is being updated
partial readable content is visible before completion
the card still shows its active streaming state
the same card contains the canonical final answer
no duplicate final message was created

scenarios.precondition: Authenticated QQ test bot conversation; synthetic data only
scenarios.send: Give a short multi-paragraph educational answer
